d: Watch this video as Firstpost explains how the United States has scored a major strategic victory against China in the global race for critical minerals. A US-led consortium, Frontier Minerals, beat out Chinese and Australian rivals to win development rights to Kenya’s Mrima Hill—a site holding over $60 billion in rare earth elements and niobium vital for green energy, aerospace, and defence. While Washington and Nairobi celebrate the deal’s promise of local refining and jobs, the mood in Kwale County is tense. Residents of the Digo ethnic community fear losing their sacred 390-acre forest…
